class.name: HTMLStyleSheet
class.brief_description: A handle to an element's stylesheet in an HTML layout.
class.description: Read [member HTMLLinkElement.sheet] or [member HTMLStyleElement.sheet] to get the stylesheet. It shares its rules with the layout's numeric CSSOM API. Changing the media condition or disabled state keeps the handle valid. Replacing the source, removing the owner from the document, or clearing or replacing the layout invalidates the handle.

method.name: delete_rule
method.description: Deletes the top-level rule at the given zero-based [param index]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a stale handle or invalid index.

method.name: get_css_rules
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the serialized top-level rules. A stale handle returns an empty array.

method.name: insert_rule
method.description: Inserts one CSS [param rule] at the given zero-based [param index]. Uses the same validation as [method HTMLLayout.insert_rule]. A stale handle returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the handle still refers to the associated stylesheet.

members.member: Whether the associated stylesheet is disabled. Set the owning element's disabled property to change this state.
The resolved resource path or final response URL of an external stylesheet. Inline stylesheets return an empty string.
The ID used by the layout's numeric CSSOM methods. A stale handle returns [code]0[/code].
The owning element's current media query list.
The element that owns the associated stylesheet. A stale handle returns [code]null[/code].
